## Goal
Every submitter result should carry a stable failure reason code so the to-do, JSON and notifications agree. That adds a field to the result type in `interfaces.py` and a case in the `--json` schema, which are in-house. Do not start until in-house adds the field.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
1. Blocked: no work until in-house adds the field and says so in a CLAUDE-G message.
2. After unblocking: every `base.py` failure path sets a code from a fixed list.

**Limits (every Grok WO, CLAUDE-G-004):** offline only. No network, credentials, git or gh, installs, or running the real app against real sites or a real mailbox; never read anything outside the repo. Fake people only (Jane Q Testperson, Springfield IL). Tests pass on Windows too (`tmp_path`, `pathlib`). Check `tests/copilot/`, `tests/codex/`, `tests/grok/` and the in-house `tests/test_*.py` first; don't duplicate a guard.

Code rules (backend WOs; owner lane change 2026-11-09):
- Change only the listed `src/` files and the new test file. No contract changes: `models.py`, `interfaces.py`, `state.py`, `registry.py`, `storage/`, `schema/`, `cli.py`, `config.py`, `paths.py`, `netpolicy.py`, `consent.py`, `crypto.py`, `secrets.py`, `secret_backends.py`, `logging_setup.py`, `engine/browser.py`. If the work needs one of them, stop and write "needs in-house contract change first" in VENDOR_STATUS.md and your GROK-NNN.
- Front end and design stay in-house: never `src/freemyid/wizard/`, `src/freemyid/templates/`, `web/`, `brand/`.
- Offline: tests use fakes and `monkeypatch`. An autouse fixture in your test file makes `socket.socket.connect` and `socket.create_connection` raise. No subprocess, no real scheduler, browser or mailbox. Never run `freemyid run`, `send` or `schedule install`.
- Every existing test keeps passing unchanged. If your change correctly breaks an in-house or Codex test, stop and report it with file:line; never edit a test outside your allowed paths.
- Typed Python 3.11+, ruff-clean, small focused diff. Logs and events stay PII-free (counts and codes only). Fake people only.
